name: Pizzeria Irene
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Irene in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Irene** in the heart of **Tirol**! Here, you’ll find authentic Italian flavors with a touch of Alpine charm. Our freshly baked pizzas, made with the finest ingredients, are the perfect start to your day or the highlight of your evening.

Indulge in our classic **Margherita**, loaded with ripe tomatoes, creamy mozzarella, and fragrant basil. Or try the **Diavola**, spicy and bold, with salami and chili flakes. For something heartier, our **Tiroler Spezial** combines traditional Italian and Austrian tastes—think crispy pancetta, melted **Käse** (cheese), and a sprinkle of fresh herbs.

Don’t miss our delicious **Tiramisu** for dessert—layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and velvety mascarpone, dusted with cocoa. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** (apple juice spritzer).

Whether you’re exploring **Innsbruck**, skiing in the **Zillertal**, or simply enjoying the scenic beauty of **Tirol**, **Pizzeria Irene** is your go-to spot for a taste of Italy with an Alpine twist. Come in, relax, and savor the flavors!
